description: The opencode harness (HARNESS H8b-2/3): launches opencode (run --format json, or the persistent opencode serve over HTTP/SSE), maps tool approval to its permissions, merges the session's MCP server and the watch plugin into its inline config, lists its models carries the / command catalog and reads its session store.
